dreamteamer.title: Roles
dreamteamer.description: `roles`: a position a person holds — team leader, backend developer, product manager, QA engineer — one record per role, and an overlay of `users` adding `roles`, so "who are the backend developers" is a filter and each role lists its people back. Depends on `users`.
